simulated_earn_read.message: This feature is unavailable in demo trading

limitations: Connected desktop private reads do not establish authenticated product-runtime integration.
Write capabilities are discovered only, never executed; read access does not prove trade permission.
Empty successful lists do not prove unavailable products, zero total assets, or absent history outside the filter.
Remote 1.5.0 and local 1.4.6 have different tool surfaces and schemas; rediscover before integration.
Read-only flash and offers endpoints can require authentication despite lacking a simulatedTrading argument.
